acceptanceCriteria.text: A bounded size/count/age retention policy is implemented and protects currently-active/reachable entries.
Index/manifest updates during eviction are atomic and crash-safe (following the existing `writeExclusiveAtomically` pattern already used for cache writes in this file).
A concurrent-GC test proves eviction running alongside a normal reader/writer does not corrupt the cache or evict an entry a concurrent reader is actively using.
A manual inspect/GC command is exposed (CLI or script) for operators to reclaim space on demand.

issue.title: feat: add retention and garbage collection to the semantic fact cache
